Definition: Jachath, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath, and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. In Josiah's day the overseers of the temple work were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, and the men did the work faithfully.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name Jahath must be held apart man by man: the father of Ahumai in Judah's line is not the Levite who oversaw Josiah's repairs, and the Bible gives each his own verse so neither is lost.
RelatedPeople: Jahath, Son of Reaiah; Jahath, Overseer
